{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''staging post''' used by one of the ancient [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] empires was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus II]], which later went into an ice age and caused the outpost to be abandoned. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the staging post was rediscovered after studies suggested that the planet had once been inhabited.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Embraced by the Ice}}</ref>
